ip_eth_rx.summary: Ethernet-to-IP receiver: a 5-state FSM walks a byte header pointer to parse IPv4 header fields into registers, checks version/IHL and ones-complement checksum, then forwards payload through a skid-buffered AXI stream.

blocks.name: rx_fsm
blocks.description: FSM sequencing header accept, header parse, payload forwarding and discard

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: Main FSM: idle, read header, read payload, payload last, wait last; drives all readies and stores

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Input stream ready, registered from FSM and output skid-buffer availability

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Ethernet header ready, asserted in idle when no IP header is pending

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output IP header valid, raised after header passes version and checksum checks

blocks.name: header_parser
blocks.description: Header pointer decodes byte position into per-field store enables filling header registers

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte counter; decoded to select which header field register stores each byte

anchors.name: store_ip_version_ihl
anchors.why: Representative per-field store enable decoded from header pointer

anchors.name: store_eth_hdr
anchors.why: Latches Ethernet MAC and type fields when header is accepted

anchors.name: m_ip_source_ip_reg
anchors.why: Representative parsed IP header field register, filled bytewise and output as header

anchors.name: m_ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Parsed IP total length; seeds payload word counter

anchors.name: m_ip_version_reg
anchors.why: Parsed IP version, checked with IHL for header validity

blocks.name: checksum
blocks.description: Ones-complement sum of header bytes compared to 0xffff

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Ones-complement header checksum accumulator checked against 0xffff

blocks.name: payload_counter
blocks.description: Counts remaining payload bytes and holds the last byte

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload byte count from IP length; detects last word and early termination

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds final payload byte while trailing padding is discarded

blocks.name: output_skid_buffer
blocks.description: Two-register skid buffer driving output payload AXI stream

anchors.name: temp_m_ip_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp register holding payload when output is stalled

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready_int_early
anchors.why: Early ready from skid buffer; gates input stream ready during payload

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable loading internal payload directly into output register

anchors.name: store_ip_payload_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Skid buffer enable storing payload into temp register on stall

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output IP payload byte stream from skid buffer output register

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload stream valid from skid buffer

blocks.name: error_status
blocks.description: Registered busy and error flag outputs

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM is not idle

anchors.name: error_invalid_header
anchors.why: Error pulse for wrong IP version or IHL

anchors.name: error_invalid_checksum
anchors.why: Error pulse when header checksum does not equal 0xffff

anchors.name: error_header_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse when tlast arrives during header

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error pulse when frame ends before IP length

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Ethernet header valid; accepted in idle to latch MAC/type and start parsing

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input byte stream carrying IP header bytes and payload

ungrouped_anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
ungrouped_anchors.why: Input payload stream valid qualifying every header/payload byte transfer

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_ready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream accepts IP header fields, clearing header valid

ungrouped_anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tready
ungrouped_anchors.why: Downstream payload ready; controls skid buffer transfers and input backpressure

ip_eth_tx.summary: IP-to-Ethernet transmitter: latches parallel IP header fields, an FSM serializes the 20-byte IPv4 header with running one's-complement checksum, then passes payload bytes through a skid-buffered AXI-stream output.

blocks.name: Frame FSM
blocks.description: Sequences header emission, payload pass-through and frame termination

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: FSM: idle, write header, write payload, last-word hold, wait last

anchors.name: store_ip_hdr
anchors.why: Load enable latching all IP and Ethernet header fields

anchors.name: store_last_word
anchors.why: Enables capture of the last payload byte

anchors.name: busy
anchors.why: Busy level when FSM not idle

anchors.name: error_payload_early_termination
anchors.why: Error flag when payload tlast arrives before length

blocks.name: Header field registers
blocks.description: Latched IP and Ethernet header fields loaded on store_ip_hdr

anchors.name: ip_length_reg
anchors.why: Latched IP length; representative of header field registers, sets payload count

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Passed-through destination MAC of the Ethernet header

blocks.name: Header serializer and checksum
blocks.description: Byte pointer muxing header fields out while summing checksum

anchors.name: hdr_ptr_reg
anchors.why: Header byte index selecting which field byte is emitted

anchors.name: hdr_sum_reg
anchors.why: Running one's-complement IP header checksum, emitted inverted

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_int
anchors.why: Output byte mux: header fields, checksum, payload or held last word

blocks.name: Payload counter
blocks.description: Counts payload bytes against IP length, holds last byte

anchors.name: word_count_reg
anchors.why: Remaining payload bytes, detects early termination and last word

anchors.name: last_word_data_reg
anchors.why: Holds last payload byte until frame tlast arrives

blocks.name: Output skid buffer
blocks.description: Two-register AXI-stream output buffer with early ready

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Internal ready of output buffer gating FSM header emission

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer temp byte when output stalls

anchors.name: store_eth_payload_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable of output register from internal datapath

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output Ethernet payload: IP header bytes then payload

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from skid buffer

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream ready controlling output and temp register moves

blocks.name: Input handshake
blocks.description: IP header and payload input handshakes and Ethernet header valid

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: IP header valid that triggers header latch and frame start

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready from FSM ready register, accepts next frame header

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Input payload bytes passed through after header

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Payload valid gating byte transfers and word count

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Payload ready from FSM, following output buffer early ready

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tlast
anchors.why: End of payload; checked against expected word count

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Ethernet header valid asserted when IP header accepted

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clearing header valid

ip.summary: IPv4 layer wrapper (8-bit): RX parser and TX framer children convert between Ethernet and IP, while a 3-state FSM resolves destination MAC via ARP before forwarding or dropping each outgoing packet.

blocks.name: ARP resolution controller
blocks.description: FSM requesting ARP lookup, latching resolved MAC, then forwarding or dropping the outgoing packet.

anchors.name: state_reg
anchors.why: IDLE/ARP_QUERY/WAIT_PACKET controller sequencing ARP lookup and outgoing packet transfer.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing IP header request; starts ARP query from IDLE.

anchors.name: arp_request_valid
anchors.why: ARP lookup request for destination IP, raised from IDLE.

anchors.name: arp_response_valid
anchors.why: ARP response arrival; moves FSM to WAIT_PACKET.

anchors.name: arp_response_mac
anchors.why: Resolved destination MAC latched into outgoing_eth_dest_mac.

anchors.name: drop_packet_reg
anchors.why: Set on ARP error; sinks outgoing payload by forcing tready.

anchors.name: outgoing_ip_hdr_valid_reg
anchors.why: Header valid into TX framer after successful ARP resolution.

anchors.name: outgoing_eth_dest_mac_reg
anchors.why: Holds ARP-resolved destination MAC for the packet being transmitted.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Outgoing payload ready: TX child ready or forced by drop_packet; ends WAIT_PACKET.

anchors.name: s_ip_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Accepts outgoing IP header once ARP response received.

anchors.name: arp_response_ready
anchors.why: Ready for ARP response, asserted during ARP query.

anchors.name: arp_request_ip
anchors.why: IP address looked up by ARP, copy of s_ip_dest_ip.

anchors.name: tx_error_arp_failed
anchors.why: Reports ARP lookup failure causing packet drop.

blocks.name: IP receive path
blocks.description: ip_eth_rx child parsing Ethernet frames into IP header fields and payload.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Received Ethernet payload bytes fed to the IP RX parser.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Received Ethernet header valid into RX parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Parsed IP payload output stream from the RX parser.

anchors.name: m_ip_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Parsed IP header valid output from RX parser.

anchors.name: rx_busy
anchors.why: RX parser busy indication.

blocks.name: IP transmit path
blocks.description: ip_eth_tx child building Ethernet frames from IP header and payload.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Transmitted Ethernet frame payload from the TX framer.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Outgoing Ethernet header valid from TX framer.

anchors.name: s_ip_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Outgoing IP payload data passed to TX framer.

anchors.name: tx_busy
anchors.why: TX framer busy indication.

anchors.name: local_mac
anchors.why: Local MAC configuration used as source MAC of transmitted frames.
